case.brief: Hollis Bakery's secret Midnight Plum Pie recipe is kept in the till drawer. On Wednesday, the rival shop Crumb & Co started selling the exact same pie. Someone copied the card.

herrings.cousin: A motive, not proof. What does the till itself remember?
herrings.devsays: That's his story. What contradicts it?

hints: The till keeps a record every time the drawer opens.
Match the cashier ID to a name.

people.name: Marta
people.says: I never touch the till. And that recipe was my grandmother's!

clue.d: Says he never opens the drawer without a sale.

people.name: Dev
people.says: I've never opened that drawer without a sale. Why would I?

clue.d: Dev's cousin works at Crumb & Co.

people.name: Owen
people.says: Crumb & Co? Dev's cousin works the counter there. Just saying.

clue.d: The drawer was opened without a sale, by cashier D-2.

places.name: The till
places.text: The register tape shows a NO SALE at 5:52 pm Tuesday: the drawer opened with nothing sold. Logged under cashier ID D-2.

places.name: Till drawer
places.text: The recipe card lives under the coin tray. It's slightly bent, as if it was pulled out and flattened for a photo.

places.name: Back door
places.text: No sign of forced entry. This was someone on the inside.

clue.d: Owen was away from 3:00 to 6:40 pm.

places.name: Van log
places.text: Van 2 (Owen): out on deliveries 3:00 pm to 6:40 pm Tuesday.

places.name: Staff rota
places.text: Cashier IDs: M-1 Marta, D-2 Dev. Tuesday close: Dev.

retorts: That's absurd, Inspector. You've got nothing on me.
Is that all you've got? My lawyer will love this.
case.title: The Midnight Plum Recipe
case.wrap: Dev opened the drawer with a NO SALE at 5:52 pm and photographed the recipe for his cousin at Crumb & Co. The register tape and the cashier IDs proved it. Crumb & Co pulled the pie, and Marta laminated her grandmother's card.
